newsitem.title: USA: Kaman to explore sale of sciences unit.
newsitem.headline: Kaman to explore sale of sciences unit.

text.p: Kaman Corp said Thursday it is exploring the possible sale of Kaman Sciences Corp, its defense-related sciences subsidiary.

Kaman Sciences, based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, provides software support, scientific research and advanced systems for the U.S. military and other government agencies and commercial organizations. It has revenues of $150 million and employs 1,200 people.
Kaman said Lazard Freres & Co will assist in exploring sale options, a process that will take several months.
Kaman said it has not had any discussions with any party to date.
